name: Provence
about: Lavender fields (peak bloom roughly late June–early August) and hill villages; late spring and early fall offer mild, fragrant, less crowded touring.
overview: Lavender fields, hilltop villages, and Roman ruins across the sun-soaked south of France.
costOverview: Market picnics and coffee are reasonable — a private lavender-fields tour or a proper Provençal dinner is where real spending happens.

specialSeasons.text: Lavender fields are in peak bloom across the Luberon and Valensole plateau.
